behavior.known_safe_failure: quarantine candidate, await title-specific release, restore exact old GPU image and log, verify title registration, mounted bytes and prior backup history
behavior.uncertain_failure: retain preserved image and log for read-only diagnosis; do not restore with uncertain FTP or mount state

limitations: No console deployment or runtime launch was attempted.
Promotion or transfer errors with uncertain FTP state require manual read-only diagnosis; automatic rollback is deliberately blocked.
The rollback success model relies on title-specific release and registration log events, which must be reviewed against live ShadowMount behavior before activation.
